name: Incordex Corp.
summary: Incordex Corp. offers specialized online services for crafting personalized, handwritten letters, which it delivers through its web platform primarily to businesses engaged in direct mail marketing. The company was founded in 2020 and is headquartered in Nuneaton, United Kingdom. As of January 13, 2025, Incordex Corp. operates as a division of HK Hangang Information Consulting Limited.
